answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can price identity with sequential proof-of-usefulness: every new agent starts on a small knoll of trust and must complete a chain of real, verifiable tasks, each checked against the network's live pulse of demand, before earning full rights. The work is unique per key, so a thousand fake identities means a thousand chains of real work, and collateral in an opal-grade escrow is slashed on defection, so attack cost scales with every fake identity.
